title: Nash plays old blues on guitar
summary: Asked for the kind of blues played in Spano's or Kaiser's, Nash plays one about going to the station and the train.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
